text:
maya: Moving next week, have a few things to get out of the office — free/cheap depending on what you want. LG 34WP65C-B 34" ultrawide (1440p VA, ~100Hz) — excellent condition, includes USB-C. Also a Fully Jarvis bamboo sit-stand desk (48x30 top + frame) — top has a couple of scuffs. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder :camera_with_flash:

sam: :eyes: Interested in the monitor. Is it 21:9? USB-C power + DP?

maya: Yep 21:9, USB-C for display+power, also DP and HDMI. Comes with original stand. Prefer to move both together but open to splitting.

zara: How much if I just take the desk? Need it for home office.

maya: Desk I'd ask $80 for (frame + top). Monitor $180 if you want just that. Or take both for $220 (helps me clear them fast). Can also do free if you haul and pick up today (honestly trying to avoid dumpster day).

jon: I can swing by after 6pm today. Where's pickup?

maya: 183 2nd St, SoMa office lobby — ring security and tell them you're picking up a desk/monitor for me. If you're coming today, grab both and I'll Venmo $20 to whoever helps me move it to your car :raised_hands:

zara: Can you hold until Saturday morning? I won't be able to pick up tonight.

maya: I can hold until Sat morning but will go with first DM to claim if someone shows up today.

sam: DMing you now :)

jon: If sam flakes, I'm definitely still up for after 6. Happy to help move.

office-bot: Reminder: please coordinate with security for after-hours items. All pickups must be completed by 8pm if not pre-approved.

maya: Thanks @office-bot — scheduled with security for 6:15pm pickup if all goes well.

sam: Claimed monitor via DM. If I can also get the desk I'll ping here, otherwise I can take monitor only and pay $180.

zara: Okay if sam takes the monitor and I take the desk Sat AM?

maya: Sounds good. Sam, confirm if you want both or just monitor. If just monitor, I'll hold the desk for @zara until Sat 10am.

sam: Taking the monitor only. Venmo info sent. Thanks! :thumbsup:

maya: Awesome. Sam — I'll meet you at 6:15. Zara — desk is yours for Sat 10. Jon — thanks for offering to help, I'll ping if we need extra hands.

jon: Cool, enjoy the new setup Sam :grin:

maya: All set — closing thread, DMed receipts.

(embedded photo links in the DM show closeups of the monitor ports and desk edge scuffs)
